posts.en:
dsh-honcho-sync is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Honcho memory bridge: auto-syncs every conversation turn to a self-hosted Honcho service, with recall/search/remember/context/status tools, context injection on session start, and a visual settings panel.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-649d094a6daef899bee7.html
